abilities.name: I Want to Help
abilities.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to 1% of Clara's ATK to a single enemy.

abilities.name: Svarog Watches Over You
abilities.text:
Deals Physical DMG equal to 1.2% of Clara's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals Physical DMG equal to 1.2% of Clara's ATK to enemies marked by Svarog with a Mark of Counter.
All Marks of Counter will be removed after this Skill is used.

abilities.name: Promise, Not Command
abilities.text:
After Clara uses Ultimate, DMG dealt to her is reduced by an extra 0.25%, and she has greatly increased chances of being attacked by enemies for 2 turn(s).
In addition, Svarog's Counter is enhanced. When an ally is attacked, Svarog immediately launches a Counter, and its DMG multiplier against the enemy increases by 1.6%. Enemies adjacent to it take 50% of the DMG dealt to the target enemy. Enhanced Counter(s) can take effect 2 time(s).

abilities.name: Because We're Family
abilities.text: Under the protection of Svarog, DMG taken by Clara when hit by enemy attacks is reduced by 0.1%. Svarog will mark enemies who attack Clara with his Mark of Counter and retaliate with a Counter, dealing Physical DMG equal to 1.6% of Clara's ATK.

abilities.name: A Small Price for Victory
abilities.text: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, the chance Clara will be attacked by enemies increases for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Kinship
abilities.desc: When attacked, this character has a 35% fixed chance to remove a debuff placed on them.

abilities.name: Under Protection
abilities.desc: The chance to resist Crowd Control Debuffs increases by 35%.

abilities.name: A Tall Figure
abilities.desc: Using Skill will not remove Marks of Counter on the enemy.

abilities.name: A Tight Embrace
abilities.desc: After using the Ultimate, ATK increases by 30% for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Cold Steel Armor
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1. up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: Family’s Warmth
abilities.desc: After Clara is hit, the DMG taken by Clara is reduced by 30%. This effect lasts until the start of her next turn.

abilities.name: A Small Promise
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Long Company
abilities.desc: After other allies are hit, Svarog also has a 50% fixed chance to trigger a Counter on the attacker and mark them with a Mark of Counter. When using Ultimate, the number of Enhanced Counters increases by 1.
